zh.name: 成品加配方卡教程
zh.summary: 先用成品照片吸引，再给可保存的材料、分量和步骤卡。
zh.useWhen: 核心是实拍结果与完整配方的配对；区别于逐页增加材料的连续镜头。
zh.instructions: 成品实拍、完整配方、份量、时间与实测步骤
zh.output: 一组保留本模板风格、叙事与钩子的 Instagram 图文。

en.name: Result and Recipe Card
en.summary: Create an Instagram how-to carousel using the result and recipe card structure. Preserve its visual hierarchy, sequence and opening payoff.
en.useWhen: Use when your content needs the result and recipe card format.
en.instructions: Provide your topic, audience, usable source material and confirmed facts.
en.output: An editable Instagram carousel with this template’s sequence and visual style.
